scope: Reader experience only; no textbook/source-content mutation.

features.fullscreen: F11 + visible button; browser Fullscreen API; immersive fallback when fullscreen is denied.
features.immersive: M toggles distraction-free reading; library navigation/top bar/mode bar/tools/status hidden; top-edge recovery HUD retained.
features.clean_reading: Enabled by default; source/provenance/OCR notes, technical source labels and identifiable footnote/source-tail markers are hidden from ordinary reading but remain in DOM and are reversible.
features.typography: ShuSong-first local Windows font stack; custom imported font is opt-in only; font-synthesis disabled; body weight 400; lighter textbook-style headings.
features.paper: Refined A4 paper background/shadow/running headers while preserving A4 and continuous modes.

limitations: No final Windows EXE is claimed for Step1; cross-building the full embedded-content executable did not finish within the available build window.
F11/native window fullscreen and actual Windows local-font rendering still require Windows-device acceptance.
No commercial ShuSong font file is redistributed; the app prefers compatible locally installed ShuSong/Song fonts.
